close_reason: Added PrincipalTasksCapability with account_id (required-nullable), may_share_with, send_to; 4 tests; 31 tests pass; clippy clean
description:
**What:** Add PrincipalTasksCapability to capability.rs. Draft-ietf-jmap-tasks-06 §2.1 defines a capability object placed on a JMAP Sharing Principal's capabilities map under "urn:ietf:params:jmap:tasks" with three fields: accountId (Id|null), mayShareWith (Boolean), sendTo (String[String]|null).

**Algorithm:**
1. In capability.rs, add:
   #[non_exhaustive]
   #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq, Serialize, Deserialize)]
   #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]
   pub struct PrincipalTasksCapability {
       pub account_id: Option<Id>,          // Id|null — no skip_serializing_if (required-nullable)
       pub may_share_with: bool,
       #[serde(skip_serializing_if = "Option::is_none")]
       pub send_to: Option<std::collections::HashMap<String, String>>,  // String[String]|null
   }
2. Add use jmap_types::Id; if not present.
3. Add pub use in lib.rs.
4. Add tests:
   - account_id: None serializes as "accountId":null (not absent)
   - account_id: Some(id) serializes correctly
   - send_to: None is absent from JSON
   - Round-trip with all fields set
5. Run cargo test -p jmap-tasks-types.

**Acceptance criteria:**
- PrincipalTasksCapability publicly accessible from crate root.
- account_id serializes as null when None (not absent).
- send_to absent when None.
- Wire names: accountId, mayShareWith, sendTo.
- cargo test -p jmap-tasks-types exits 0. Clippy clean.
title: Add PrincipalTasksCapability struct (tasks-06 §2.1)
